cards.name: Ampharos
cards.description: The tip of its tail shines brightly. In the olden days, people sent signals using the tail's light.

cards.name: Ho-Oh
cards.description: Its feathers are in seven colors. It is said that anyone seeing it is promised eternal happiness.

cards.name: Psyduck
cards.description: If its usual headache worsens, its starts exhibiting odd powers. It can't remember doing so, however.

cards.name: Qwilfish
cards.description: It shoots the poison spines on its body in all directions. Its round form makes it a poor swimmer.

cards.name: Ralts
cards.description: It uses the thorns on its head to sense human emotions. It is said to appear in front of cheerful people.

cards.name: Rattata
cards.description: Cautious in the extreme, its hardy vitality lets it live in any kind of environment.

cards.name: Sentret
cards.description: It has a very nervous nature. It stands up high on its tail so it can scan wide areas.

cards.name: Shellder
cards.description: It swims backwards by opening and closing its two shells. Its large tongue is always kept hanging out.

cards.name: Shellos East Sea
cards.description: Its colors and shapes differ from region to region. In the Sinnoh region, two types are confirmed.

cards.name: Shellos West Sea
cards.description: Its colors and shapes differ from region to region. In the Sinnoh region, two types are confirmed.

cards.name: Shroomish
cards.description: It spouts poison spores from the top of its head. These spores cause pain all over if inhaled.

cards.name: Shuckle
cards.description: It stores berries in its shell. The berries eventually ferment to become delicious juices.

cards.name: Jumpluff
cards.description: Blown by seasonal winds, it circles the globe, scattering cotton spores as it goes.

cards.name: Shuppet
cards.description: It loves vengeful emotions and hangs in rows under the eaves of houses where vengeful people live.

cards.name: Spinda
cards.description: No two Spinda have the same pattern of spots. Its tottering step fouls the aim of foes.

cards.name: Squirtle
cards.description: It shelters itself in its shell, then strikes back with spouts of water at every opportunity.

cards.name: Stantler
cards.description: Staring at its antlers creates an odd sensation as if one were being drawn into their centers.

cards.name: Sunkern
cards.description: It suddenly falls out of the sky in the morning. A year after a cold summer, their population explodes.

cards.name: Trapinch
cards.description: It makes a conical pit in desert sand and lies in wait at the bottom for prey to come tumbling down.

cards.name: Venonat
cards.description: Its big eyes are actually clusters of tiny eyes. At nights, its kind is drawn by light.

cards.name: Voltorb
cards.description: It looks just like a Poké Ball. It is dangerous because it may electrocute or explode on touch.

cards.name: Wooper
cards.description: It lives in cold water, half burying itself in mud at the bottom to sleep.

cards.name: Lickilicky
cards.description: It wraps things with its extensible tongue. Getting to close to it will leave you soaked with drool.

cards.name: Ludicolo
cards.description: If it hears festive music, all its muscles fill with energy. It can't help breaking out into a dance.

cards.name: Lugia
cards.description: It sleeps in a deep-sea trench. If it flaps its wings, it is said to cause a 40-day storm.

cards.name: Mew
cards.description: Because it can use all kinds of moves, many scientists believe MEW to be the ancestor of Pokémon.

cards.name: Raikou
cards.description: It is said to have fallen with lightning. It can fire thunderbolts from the rain clouds on its back.

cards.name: Roserade
cards.description: It attracts prey with a sweet aroma, then downs it with thorny whips hidden in its arms.

cards.name: Salamence
cards.description: As a result of its long-held dream of flying, its cellular structure changes, and wings grew out.

cards.name: Suicune
cards.description: It races around the world to purify fouled water. It dashes away with the north wind.

cards.name: Blastoise
cards.description: The jets of water it spouts from the rocket cannons on its shell can punch through thick steel.

cards.name: Venusaur
cards.description: After a rainy day, the flower on its back smells stronger. The scent attracts other Pokémon.

cards.name: Absol
cards.description: It senses disasters coming and appears before people only to warn them of impending danger.

cards.name: Arcanine
cards.description: Its proud and regal appearance has captured the hearts of people since long ago.

cards.name: Banette
cards.description: A doll that became a Pokémon over its grudge from being junked. It seeks the child that disowned it.

cards.name: Dugtrio
cards.description: Its three heads moves alternately, driving it through tough soil to depths of over 60 miles.

cards.name: Electivire
cards.description: It pushes the tips of its two tails against the foe, then lets loose with over 20,000 volts of power.

cards.name: Electrode
cards.description: It is known to drift on winds if it is bloated to bursting with stored electricity.

cards.name: Furret
cards.description: The mother puts its offspring to sleep by curling up around them. It corners foes with speed.

cards.name: Golduck
cards.description: A Pokémon that lives in lakes. It swims faster than any human swimming champion.

cards.name: Golem
cards.description: It sheds its hide once a year. Its boulderlike body is so tough, even dynamite can't harm it.

cards.name: Charizard
cards.description: It is said that CHARIZARD's fire burns hotter if it has experienced harsh battles.

cards.name: Jynx
cards.description: It cries sound like human speech. However, it is impossible to tell what it is trying to say.

cards.name: Magmortar
cards.description: It blasts fireballs of over 3,600 degrees F from the ends of its arms. It lives in volcanic craters.

cards.name: Minun
cards.description: It cheers on friends. If its friends are losing, its body lets off more and more sparks.

cards.name: Mothim
cards.description: It loves the honey of flowers and steals honey collected by COMBEE.

cards.name: Nidoking
cards.description: One swing of its mighty tail can snap a telephone pole as if it were a matchstick.

cards.name: Pidgeot
cards.description: By flapping its wings with all its might, PIDGEOT can make a gust of wind capable of bending tall trees.

cards.name: Plusle
cards.description: It cheers on friends with pom-poms made of sparks. It drains power from telephone poles.

cards.name: Sharpedo
cards.description: Its fangs rip through sheet iron. It swims at 75 mph and is known as "The Bully of the Sea."

cards.name: Sunflora
cards.description: It gets energy from warm sunlight and is known for its habit of moving in pursuit of it.

cards.name: Unown S
cards.description: Shaped like ancient writing, it is a huge mystery whether language or UNOWN came first.

cards.name: Entei
cards.description: It is said that when it roars, a volcano erupts somewhere around the globe.

cards.name: Weavile
cards.description: They live in cold regions, forming groups of four or five that hunt prey with impressive coordination.

cards.name: Wormadam Plant Cloak
cards.description: When BURMY evolved, its cloak became a part of this Pokémon's body. The cloak is never shed.

cards.name: Wormadam Sandy Cloak
cards.description: When BURMY evolved, its cloak became a part of this Pokémon's body. The cloak is never shed.

cards.name: Wormadam Trash Cloak
cards.description: When BURMY evolved, its cloak became a part of this Pokémon's body. The cloak is never shed.

cards.name: Xatu
cards.description: This odd Pokémon can see both the past and the future. It eyes the sun's movement all day.

cards.name: Breloom
cards.description: Its short arms stretch when it throws punches. Its technique is equal to that of pro boxers.

cards.name: Charmeleon
cards.description: In the rocky mountains where CHARMELEON live, their fiery tails shine at night like stars.

cards.name: Cloyster
cards.description: It fights by keeping its shell tightly shut for protection and by shooting spikes to repel foes.

cards.name: Donphan
cards.description: It attacks by curling up, then rolling into its foe. It can blow apart a house in one hit.

cards.name: Farfetch'd
cards.description: It can't live without the stalk it holds. That's why it defends the stalk from attackers with its life.

cards.name: Flygon
cards.description: It whips up sandstorms with powerful flaps of its wings. It is known as "The Desert Spirit."

cards.name: Flaaffy
cards.description: If its coat becomes fully charged with electricity, its tail lights up. It fires hair that zaps on impact.

cards.name: Ivysaur
cards.description: When the bud on its back starts swelling, a sweet aroma wafts to indicate the flower's coming bloom.

cards.name: Kecleon
cards.description: It can freely change its body's color. The zigzag pattern on its belly doesn't change, however.

cards.name: Kirlia
cards.description: It is highly perceptive of its Trainer's feelings. It dances when it is feeling happy.

cards.name: Lombre
cards.description: It has a mischievous spirit. If it spots an angler, it will tug on the fishing line to interfere.

cards.name: Miltank
cards.description: It is said that kids who drink MILTANK's milk grow up to become hearty, healthy adults.

cards.name: Muk
cards.description: A toxic fluids seeps from its body. The fluid instantly kills plants and trees on contact.

cards.name: Nidorino
cards.description: It has a violent disposition and stabs foes with its horn, which oozes poison upon impact.

cards.name: Pidgeotto
cards.description: It flies over its wide territory in search of prey, downing it with its highly developed claws.

cards.name: Pinsir
cards.description: It grips prey with its pincers until the prey is torn in half. What it can't tear, it tosses far.

cards.name: Gallade
cards.description: A master of courtesy and swordsmanship, it fights using extending swords on its elbows.

cards.name: Quagsire
cards.description: It has a sluggish nature. It lies at the river's bottom, waiting for prey to stray into its mouth.

cards.name: Raticate
cards.description: It whittles its constantly growing fangs by gnawing on hard things. It can chew apart cinder walls.

cards.name: Roselia
cards.description: ROSELIA raised on clean drinking water are known to grow vividly colored flowers.

cards.name: Sableye
cards.description: It hides in the darkness of caves. Its diet of gems has transformed its eyes into gemstones.

cards.name: Shelgon
cards.description: Within its rugged shell, its cells have begun changing. The shell peels off the instant it evolves.

cards.name: Skiploom
cards.description: It blooms when the weather warms. It floats in the sky to soak up as much sunlight as possible.

cards.name: Smeargle
cards.description: It marks its territory by using its tail like a paintbrush. There are more than 5,000 different marks.

cards.name: Smoochum
cards.description: It tests everything by touching with its lips, which remember what it likes and dislikes.

cards.name: Unown K
cards.description: Shaped like ancient writing, it is a huge mystery whether language or UNOWN came first.

cards.name: Unown N
cards.description: Shaped like ancient writing, it is a huge mystery whether language or UNOWN came first.

cards.name: Gardevoir
cards.description: It will try to guard its trusted Trainer with its life. It has the ability to see the future.

cards.name: Unown O
cards.description: Shaped like ancient writing, it is a huge mystery whether language or UNOWN came first.

cards.name: Unown X
cards.description: Shaped like ancient writing, it is a huge mystery whether language or UNOWN came first.

cards.name: Unown Z
cards.description: Shaped like ancient writing, it is a huge mystery whether language or UNOWN came first.

cards.name: Venomoth
cards.description: It flutters its wings to scatter dustlike scales. The scales leach toxins if they contact skin.

cards.name: Vibrava
cards.description: It violently shudders its wings, generating ultrasonic waves to induce headaches in people.

cards.name: Wartortle
cards.description: It is said to live 10,000 years. Its furry tail is popular as a symbol of longevity.

cards.name: Bagon
cards.description: Dreaming of one day flying, it practices by leaping off cliffs every day.

cards.name: Bulbasaur
cards.description: For some time after its birth, it grows by gaining nourishment from the seed on its back.

cards.name: Burmy Plant Cloak
cards.description: To shelter itself from cold, wintry winds, it covers itself with a cloak made of twigs and leaves.

cards.name: Burmy Sandy Cloak
cards.description: To shelter itself from cold, wintry winds, it covers itself with a cloak made of twigs and leaves.

cards.name: Gastrodon East Sea
cards.description: It has a pliable body without any bones. If any part of its body is torn off, it grows right back.

cards.name: Burmy Trash Cloak
cards.description: To shelter itself from cold, wintry winds, it covers itself with a cloak made of twigs and leaves.

cards.name: Carvanha
cards.description: They can swarm any foe that invades their territory. Their sharp fangs can tear out boat hulls.

cards.name: Charmander
cards.description: The fire on the tip of its tail is a measure of its life. If healthy, its tail burns intensely.

cards.name: Corsola
cards.description: Many live in the clean seas of the south. They apparently can't live in polluted waters.

cards.name: Diglett
cards.description: A Pokémon that lives underground. Because of its dark habitat, it is repelled by bright sunlight.

cards.name: Electabuzz
cards.description: Half of all blackouts occur when this Pokémon appears at power plants and eats electricity.

cards.name: Grimer
cards.description: It was born when sludge in a dirty stream was exposed to the moon's X-rays. It appears among filth.

cards.name: Growlithe
cards.description: A Pokémon with a loyal nature. It will remain motionless until it is given an order by its Trainer.

cards.name: Gastrodon West Sea
cards.description: It has a pliable body without any bones. If any part of its body is torn off, it grows right back.

cards.name: Hoppip
cards.description: It drifts on winds. It is said that when HOPPIP gather in fields and mountains, spring is on the way.

cards.name: Lickitung
cards.description: Instead of hands, it uses its tongue, which is twice its height. Its sticky saliva grips anything.

cards.name: Lotad
cards.description: It looks like an aquatic plant and serves as a ferry to Pokémon that can't swim.

cards.name: Magmar
cards.description: Born in the spout of a volcano, its body is covered by flames that shimmer like the sun.

cards.name: Mareep
cards.description: Its fluffy coat swells to double when static electricity builds up. Touching it can be shocking.

cards.name: Natu
cards.description: It picks food from cactus plants, deftly avoiding buds and spines. It seems to skip about to move.

cards.name: Nidoran♂
cards.description: It scans its surroundings by raising its ears out of the grass. Its toxic horn is for protection.

cards.name: Phanpy
cards.description: It is strong despite its compact size. It can easily pick up and carry an adult human on its back.

cards.name: Pidgey
cards.description: It is docile and prefers to avoid conflict. If disturbed, however, it can ferociously strike back.
